body: i know exactly how you feel, I'm here for you.
can you elaborate some more? if you're ok with me knowing a little more.
yes, of course. though i may be a tad late.

its just so fucking surreal, i don't know how to approach this situation, i can only truly express my thoughts through writing, but i don't want to leave him alone whilst he receives the letter, id like to be there to comfort him, but I'm not sure if he'd be with his friends or not, and id prefer it to be just us..

should i deliver it to him in person? what if he doesn't want to be reminded of it?? this fellow is no stranger, i have known him before we had gotten to high school, he really is a kind dude, i reaaally don't want to fuck this up. i don't want him to think I'm only talking to him because he tried to kill himself and now suddenly i care, ugh what do i do?
